model.name: H3 First / Last — Full
model.description: Full 33B MiniMax H3 First / Last model. Creates video from text alone or with a first frame, last frame, or both, and generates synchronized stereo audio. Longer Studio clips continue through native 14.4-second windows. It does not accept reference audio. Turbo works with both Full and Pruned; use Full only when you specifically want its larger checkpoint.

prompt: A cinematic medium shot of a traveler standing on a windswept overlook at sunrise. The camera slowly arcs around them as their coat moves naturally in the breeze. Distant birds and soft wind are audible, and the traveler says, "We made it."
